description: Use this when someone asks how much paint they need for a room, walls or a ceiling. Calculates the paint for a room: the wall area 2 × (length + width) × height, or a given wall area, less the doors and windows (36 × 80 in and 36 × 60 in each unless given), plus the ceiling (length × width) when asked, times the coats, divided by the coverage. Returns the areas in square meters and the paint in liters, in all and for walls and ceiling (1 US gallon = 3.785411784 l). Coverage when not given: 350 sq ft per gallon (8.59 m² per liter), the low end of Sherwin-Williams' 350–400; the can label is more exact.

ceiling.description: True to paint the ceiling too; needs length and width.

coats.description: Coats of paint; 2 when left out.

coverage.description: Square meters one liter covers in one coat, from the can; 8.59 (350 sq ft per US gallon) when left out.

doorHeight.description: Height of one door; 2032 (80 in) when left out, in millimeters.

doorWidth.description: Width of one door; 914.4 (36 in) when left out, in millimeters.

doors.description: Number of doors to leave out; none when left out.

height.description: Wall height, floor to ceiling, in millimeters.

walls.description: Wall area in square meters, used instead of length, width and height.

windowHeight.description: Height of one window; 1524 (60 in) when left out, in millimeters.

windowWidth.description: Width of one window; 914.4 (36 in) when left out, in millimeters.

windows.description: Number of windows to leave out; none when left out.

name: calculate_paint
